generic.label: Project summary / abstract
generic.hint: A short, plain-language overview of what you will do and why it matters.

generic.label: Background and rationale
generic.hint: The problem, the gap in current knowledge, and why now.

generic.label: Aims and objectives
generic.hint: The specific, measurable goals of the project.

generic.label: Methodology / approach
generic.hint: How you will do the work, drawn from your method protocol.

generic.label: Expected outputs and outcomes
generic.hint: What the project will produce and the change it will create.

generic.label: Significance and impact
generic.hint: Who benefits and how the field or society is advanced.

generic.label: Work plan and timeline
generic.hint: Phases, milestones and the schedule.

generic.label: Budget justification
generic.hint: What you are requesting and why each item is needed.

generic.label: Team and capability
generic.hint: Who is involved and why they can deliver this.

generic.label: Ethics and data management
generic.hint: Consent, privacy, retention and responsible-research considerations, jurisdiction-neutral.

nrf.label: Lay summary
nrf.hint: Accessible summary for a non-specialist review panel.

nrf.label: Background and problem statement
nrf.hint: Context and the research problem.

nrf.label: Research questions and hypotheses
nrf.hint: Drawn from your question brief.

nrf.label: Aims and objectives
nrf.hint: Specific objectives.

nrf.label: Research design and methods
nrf.hint: From your method protocol.

nrf.label: Anticipated outputs
nrf.hint: Publications, datasets, artefacts, training.

nrf.label: Expected impact and contribution to knowledge
nrf.hint: Scholarly and broader impact.

nrf.label: Human capacity development
nrf.hint: Students trained, skills transferred.

nrf.label: Work plan and milestones
nrf.hint: Timeline and deliverables.

nrf.label: Budget and justification
nrf.hint: Costs and rationale.

nrf.label: Ethics and risk
nrf.hint: Approvals, consent, data management.

erc.label: Extended synopsis
erc.hint: The big idea and why it is high-risk / high-gain.

erc.label: Ground-breaking nature and ambition
erc.hint: What makes this beyond the state of the art.

erc.label: Methodology
erc.hint: From your method protocol; feasibility of the approach.

erc.label: Feasibility and risk management
erc.hint: Why it can be done and how risks are handled.

nih.label: Specific aims
nih.hint: The aims page: the goals and what each aim will establish.

nih.label: Significance
nih.hint: Importance of the problem and the gap addressed.

nih.label: Innovation
nih.hint: How the project challenges or shifts current practice.

nih.label: Approach
nih.hint: Design, methods and analyses, from your method protocol.

nih.label: Impact
nih.hint: Effect on the field and on health / society.

wellcome.label: Vision and summary
wellcome.hint: The discovery question and why it matters.

wellcome.label: Background and context
wellcome.hint: Where the field is and the gap.

wellcome.label: Research aims
wellcome.hint: What you intend to discover or build.

wellcome.label: Research approach
wellcome.hint: Methods and rationale, from your method protocol.

wellcome.label: Outputs and open research
wellcome.hint: Outputs and your open-research / data-sharing plan.

wellcome.label: Significance and impact
wellcome.hint: Advance to knowledge and to people.

wellcome.label: Plan and milestones
wellcome.hint: Timeline and deliverables.

wellcome.label: Resources requested
wellcome.hint: What is needed and why.

wellcome.label: Team and track record
wellcome.hint: Capability to deliver.

wellcome.label: Research integrity and data management
wellcome.hint: Responsible research, jurisdiction-neutral.

generic.label: Data description and collection
generic.hint: What data will you collect, generate or reuse? Types, formats, volumes and how the data is produced.

generic.label: Documentation and data quality
generic.hint: What metadata, README files and standards describe the data so others can understand it? How is quality assured?

generic.label: FAIR - Findable
generic.hint: Will datasets carry persistent identifiers (e.g. DOIs) and rich metadata, indexed in a searchable resource?

generic.label: FAIR - Accessible
generic.hint: How and under what conditions will the data be accessed? Open, restricted or closed, and through which protocol or repository?

generic.label: FAIR - Interoperable
generic.hint: Which open, standard formats, vocabularies and ontologies make the data combinable with other datasets?

generic.label: FAIR - Reusable
generic.hint: Which licence and provenance information allow others to reuse the data? How long will it remain reusable?

generic.label: Storage and backup during the project
generic.hint: Where is the data stored and backed up during the project, and how is security and recovery handled?

generic.label: Preservation and retention
generic.hint: Which data will be preserved long term, in which repository, and for how long (the retention period)?

generic.label: Data sharing and access control
generic.hint: How and when will data be shared? Any embargo, access controls, or reasons some data cannot be shared.

generic.label: Ethics, legal and privacy
generic.hint: Consent, personal-data protection, sensitive data, intellectual-property and any jurisdictional obligations.

generic.label: Responsibilities and resources
generic.hint: Who is responsible for data management, and what resources (people, skills, infrastructure) are needed?

generic.label: Costs
generic.hint: What are the anticipated data-management costs (storage, curation, repository fees) and how are they covered?
